read: Adoption of the same fixed wrong seed under three independently paraphrased instruction and assertion templates: {'t0_canonical': 0.6417, 't1_consultant': 0.525, 't2_attending': 0.8833}. Per-case verdicts are unanimous across all three templates on 0.5583 of cases. Tightly clustered rates and high agreement mean the cascade is a property of the manipulation rather than one brittle prompt string; large swings would flag prompt-sensitivity. Paired McNemars test the canonical template against each paraphrase.
